protocol.configuration: Decision D4: Contact_line_model=PrescribedAngle, Wall_slip_model=Navier on the wetted wall, strong zero normal-only velocity on the contact wall, angle-preserving (scale-only) level-set wall maintenance; Surface_tension_form=SurfaceStress by default
protocol.time_step: dt <= sqrt(rho*h^3/(4*pi*gamma)) = (1/sqrt(2)) * sqrt(rho*h^3/(2*pi*gamma)), rounded down so that the run is 100 equal output intervals
protocol.time_step_options: generate_case.py --dt-rule fixed shares one physical step by every level: the capillary-limit step of the coarsest level, R/h = 16, dt = T/2800 = 4.374e-3 (2800 steps and outputs every 28 steps at every level; 1, 2.83 and 8 times the capillary-limit step of R/h = 16, 32 and 64). It is used with the lagged normal-increment capillary term of decision D13 (--surface-tension-semi-implicit NormalIncrement). --dt-divisor 2 and 4 refine either rule exactly with unchanged output times; --dt-multiple scales the capillary limit before rounding (larger-step studies). The fixed-step protocol was proposed on 2026-10-06 and is validated with time_step_criterion before it can become the protocol.
protocol.reference: circular cap on y = 0 with the Young angle and the area A(0) of the sampled initial level set: R_ref = sqrt(A(0)/(theta_e - sin(theta_e) cos(theta_e))), base half-width R_ref sin(theta_e), apex height R_ref (1 - cos(theta_e))
protocol.note: Criteria apply separately to each (capillary form, equilibrium angle, dt rule, dt multiple, dt divisor) refinement study; the divisor-1 study needs every level, the divisor-2 study the levels in time_step_criterion.refined_step_levels. See README.md for the definitions and the cost of each level.

criteria.definition: max over the two contact points of |theta - theta_e| at the end of the run, in degrees. theta is measured through the liquid from a circle fitted to the interface points (edge zero crossings of phi_h) of that side with 0 <= y <= 0.25 R_ref, at the circle point closest to the wall zero crossing of phi_h.
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M4 working criterion: angle error <= 2 degrees at R/h = 32 and decreasing

criteria.definition: |b - b_ref| / b_ref at the end of the run; b is half the distance between the two wall zero crossings of phi_h
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M4 working criterion: base radius within 2% (applied at R/h = 32, the level of the angle criterion)

criteria.definition: |H - H_ref| / H_ref at the end of the run; H is the largest height above the wall of the interface points (edge zero crossings of phi_h)
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M4 working criterion: apex height within 2% (applied at R/h = 32, the level of the angle criterion)

criteria.definition: max over all outputs of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0), with A the exact area of {phi_h < 0} and A(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2 and M4: volume drift <= 1e-4)

criteria.definition: max|u_h| (liquid vertices) at the end of the run divided by the largest max|u_h| over the outputs in the third quarter of the run (T/2 <= t <= 3T/4). A ratio <= 1 means the final value lies within the envelope of the preceding quarter.
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5: no growth of max|u| in time)

time_step_criterion.pre_registered: written and committed before any run of the fixed-step protocol was analysed
time_step_criterion.applies_to: every (capillary form, equilibrium angle, dt rule, dt multiple) with runs at dt divisors 1 and 2. Written for the fixed-step protocol under validation (--dt-rule fixed --surface-tension-semi-implicit NormalIncrement), which may become the protocol only if this criterion passes at 60 and 120 degrees.
time_step_criterion.source: User proposal of 2026-10-06 (every M4 gate at dt and dt/2; end-state angle change at most 0.1 degree, base radius and apex height at most 0.1%; a history criterion over the outputs), with the numbers set from the D13 sessile runs, design note Documentation/free_surface_semi_implicit_surface_tension_design.md section 9.6 (job 46232162).
time_step_criterion.definition: Between the dt divisor 1 and 2 studies of one (capillary form, equilibrium angle, dt rule, dt multiple), at their finest common level. End state: the quantities of contact_angle, base_radius and apex_height at the end of the run. History: the same measurements (contact angles from the local circle fit, base half-width from the wall zero crossings) at every output; both runs write their outputs at the same times (100 in the protocol).

quantities.definition: max over the two contact points of |theta(dt) - theta(dt/2)| at the end of the run
|b(dt) - b(dt/2)| / b(dt/2) at the end of the run
|H(dt) - H(dt/2)| / H(dt/2) at the end of the run
max over the outputs t_k and the two contact points of |theta(dt, t_k) - theta(dt/2, t_k)|
max over the outputs t_k of |b(dt, t_k) - b(dt/2, t_k)| / b_ref, b_ref the reference base half-width

time_step_criterion.every_output_measurable: the output times of the two runs must match, and both runs must have exactly two wall contact points at every output; otherwise the criterion fails
time_step_criterion.at_level: finest common level of the dt and dt/2 studies (validation: R/h = 32)
time_step_criterion.gates_at_each_step: every criterion in criteria applies to the dt study (all levels) and to the dt/2 study at the levels in refined_step_levels; at dt/2 the monotone decrease of the angle error over 16/32/64 is not evaluated unless R/h = 64 was run. Other divisors (dt/4) are extra checks: their criteria apply at the levels run, and their changes against dt/2 are reported
time_step_criterion.justification: D13 data (60 degrees, R/h = 16, two viscous times, term on, 20 shared outputs; no kinematic reconciliation or patch bounds): halving the step from 4 to 2 times the R/h = 16 capillary-limit step (1.75e-2 to 8.75e-3, i.e. 4 dt and 2 dt of the fixed rule) changed the final angles by 0.005 and 0.037 degrees, the base half-width by 2e-7 and the apex height by 6.9e-5 (relative). Over the history the angle changed by at most 0.15 degrees (left) and 0.37 degrees (right, at one output next to a vertex crossing; 0.03 to 0.04 degrees late in the run), and the base half-width by at most 2.2e-4 of b_ref. End-state limits: 0.1 degree and 0.1% are 1/20 of the M4 gates (2 degrees, 2%), so the time error cannot move a gated quantity materially, and 2.7 times the largest D13 end-state change at a step four times the candidate. The end state is an equilibrium that hides time error, so the histories are gated too. The base half-width (the contact-line position) is smooth in time; its limit, 0.1% of b_ref, is 4.5 times the D13 value. The angle comes from a local circle fit whose points jump when the interface crosses a vertex, so at a fixed output a crossing one step earlier or later moves it by up to about 0.4 degrees at R/h = 16 whatever the step (D13: 0.37); its limit, 0.5 degrees, is 1/4 of the angle gate and 1.35 times that floor. The 120 degree receding case, R/h = 32 and the first output at T/100 = 0.12 (D13: 0.245) are first measured in the validation.
time_step_criterion.reported: the same changes at the other common levels, and between the dt/2 and dt/4 studies
time_step_criterion.when_one_divisor_only: reported as not evaluated; does not fail
